list: GTA VI - official PS5 trophy list (verified 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is one of the opening story missions, and finishing it pops this trophy on the mission-complete screen. Play it through without skipping the closing cutscene; if the trophy does not land, the mission replay in the chapter menu re-triggers it. Basis: name and description per the Exophase (PSN) listing, mirrored by XCT.live (Xbox catalog).
steps: Start Chapter 1 and follow the story markers until Gone Fishing begins.
Complete every objective of the fishing trip - catch what the mission asks for and return to shore.
Let the closing cutscene play out; the trophy registers as the mission completes.
trophies.requirements: None - reached in the normal course of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A pure story trophy: finish every mission of Chapter 1 and this lands with the chapter-end sequence. Nothing in the chapter is missable for this trophy - side content can wait. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; chapter structure per Output Lag.
steps: Work through the Chapter 1 mission chain in order.
Finish the chapter finale and watch the closing sequence.
The trophy pops as Chapter 2 opens.
trophies.requirements: None beyond starting the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The platform name is served censored - T**s Ass Drug Money - and the trophy is the chapter-complete award, so steady story progress is the whole method. Basis: Exophase (PSN) and XCT.live (Xbox catalog) agree on the censored name; chapter award per Output Lag.
steps: Complete the Chapter 2 mission chain.
Finish the chapter finale.
The trophy registers on the chapter-complete screen.
trophies.requirements: Chapter 1 completed (Paradise Lost).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. As with the other chapter trophies there is no side requirement - the award is the chapter itself. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same chapter award.
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 mission chain.
Finish the chapter finale.
The trophy registers on the chapter-complete screen.
trophies.requirements: Chapter 2 completed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last of the numbered chapter awards before the endgame; nothing optional gates it. Basis: Exophase (PSN) and XCT.live (Xbox catalog) listings.
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 mission chain.
Finish the chapter finale.
The trophy registers on the chapter-complete screen.
trophies.requirements: Chapter 3 completed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the gold story award and the natural end of the roadmap's story spine; everything else on the list can be finished before or after it. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; finale placement per Output Lag.
steps: Reach the final mission through the chapter chain.
Complete it and let the ending sequence finish.
The trophy pops at the story's conclusion.
trophies.requirements: Chapters 1-4 completed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission, and Trust is its completion award. It sits early in the chapter flow, so most players earn it without trying. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; mission placement per Output Lag.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run is offered.
Complete the run and its closing objective.
The trophy registers at mission complete.
trophies.requirements: Story progress into Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the game's headline set-piece score, and Break the Bank is its completion award. Bring ammo and armour into it; the award itself only asks for completion, on any approach. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; heist placement per Output Lag.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story chain.
Fight or sneak through the heist and escape with the take.
The trophy registers as the mission completes.
trophies.requirements: Story progress into the later chapters.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission; Family Matters is its completion award. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing, mirrored by XCT.live (Xbox catalog).
steps: Play the story until Child's Play is offered.
Complete its objectives and the closing scene.
The trophy registers at mission complete.
trophies.requirements: Story progress into Chapter 2.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission and DWNFALL - all caps, as served - is its completion award. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; the all-caps styling is confirmed by XCT.live (Xbox catalog).
steps: Play the story until Headliners is offered.
Complete the mission and its finale.
The trophy registers at mission complete.
trophies.requirements: Story progress into Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission built around the airport authority; Hi-Jacked is its completion award. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; mission placement per Output Lag.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown is offered.
Complete the takedown and the escape that follows.
The trophy registers at mission complete.
trophies.requirements: Story progress into the later chapters.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission; Snow Storm is its completion award. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing, mirrored by XCT.live (Xbox catalog).
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory is offered.
Complete the operation's objectives.
The trophy registers at mission complete.
trophies.requirements: Story progress into the later chapters.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: A Long Road is the 100% completion award and the second gold on the list. The in-game 100% checklist is the authority: story, strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed it. Work the roadmap in order and use the board's per-kind counts to find what is left. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Push Square reported this trophy by name at launch.
steps: Finish the story spine (roadmap steps 1-3 and the finale in step 7).
Clear every stranger strand (step 4) and the activity set (step 5).
Sweep collectibles and exploration until the in-game checklist reads 100%.
The trophy registers the moment the checklist completes.
trophies.requirements: Effectively the whole game - see the roadmap.
trophies.effort: The long road - 60+ hours across the whole list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts - the jumps and stunt spots scattered over Leonida. They are one-and-done each, so route them by district instead of hunting one at a time, and keep a fast, sturdy car or bike as your stunt vehicle. The counter only moves on a landed, registered stunt. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; count per Output Lag.
steps: Unlock a reliable stunt vehicle early (a fast sports bike works almost everywhere).
Sweep stunt spots district by district, using the map to chain nearby spots.
Re-attempt failed landings immediately - only clean completions register.
Repeat until the counter reaches 250.
trophies.requirements: Open-world access; a fast vehicle helps throughout.
trophies.effort: Long grind, 6-10 hours spread across the map

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once - races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games and the rest of the activity families each need a single attempt, not a win. It is the cheapest tour of what Leonida offers, and it teaches you which activities the other trophies will ask you to master. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; activity families per Output Lag.
steps: Open the map and note one marker of each activity type.
Attempt each type once - finishing is enough, winning is not required.
Check the trophy after each new type; it pops when the last family is sampled.
trophies.requirements: Open-world access after the opening missions.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Golds are score thresholds, so learn each challenge's target order, use the weapon the challenge favours, and restart freely - attempts are cheap and the medal, not the attempt count, is what matters. Save the strictest accuracy challenges for last, once the range feels familiar. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; medal structure per Output Lag.
steps: Clear every range challenge once to learn its targets and par score.
Re-run each challenge with its best-fit weapon, prioritising accuracy streaks over speed.
Restart the moment a gold pace is lost - there is no penalty for retrying.
The trophy registers when the last challenge turns gold.
trophies.requirements: Shooting Range access; a spread of owned weapons helps.
trophies.effort: Skill grind, 2-4 hours of range time

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. One win per course is enough - you do not need gold times. Learn each course with a sighting run, then race it properly; drone handling rewards smooth lines over full throttle. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; per-location wins per Output Lag.
steps: Visit each Top Fun location and learn the course with a practice run.
Race again for the win, cutting corners on the racing line rather than chasing speed.
Tick locations off as you win them; the trophy pops on the final location's win.
trophies.requirements: Open-world access to every race location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races - repeats of the same race do not stack. Mix street, off-road and drone events to keep it fresh, and bring an upgraded vehicle to the harder brackets. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; the different-races condition per Output Lag.
steps: Win the entry-level race in each discipline to open its ladder.
Work across the map so every win is a new event.
Upgrade your main race vehicle before the top brackets.
The trophy registers on the 20th distinct win.
trophies.requirements: A competitive vehicle for the later brackets.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the game's fishing regular; his challenge unlocks through the fishing strand, and the contest itself is a fair catch-off - use the best rod and bait you have and play the fish patiently rather than horsing it in. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same condition.
steps: Progress the fishing strand until Cal offers his challenge.
Stock your best rod and bait before accepting.
Out-catch Cal inside the challenge rules - steady pressure beats frantic reeling.
The trophy registers when the challenge is won.
trophies.requirements: Fishing unlocked; Cal's strand started.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game - one full cabinet run, start to finish, anywhere in Leonida. Pick the shortest cabinet you find, learn its loop, and see it through; quitting mid-game does not count. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same condition.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in any venue with games.
Start a game and play it to its natural end - win or lose, finish it.
The trophy registers when the game completes.
trophies.requirements: Access to any arcade cabinet.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy - the closing chapter of his stranger strand. Strands open as map markers after their introduction; work each of Andy's missions as they appear and the strand finale awards this. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; strand structure per Output Lag.
steps: Meet Andy at his strand marker and complete his opening mission.
Return for each follow-up mission as the strand advances.
Finish the strand's final mission; the trophy registers at its close.
trophies.requirements: Andy's strand unlocked through story progress.
trophies.effort: Strand length, ~1 hour across its missions

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His strand runs on the water as much as the road - keep a boat handy. The trophy is the strand finale award. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing, mirrored by XCT.live (Xbox catalog).
steps: Meet Kenton and complete his opening mission.
Work through his follow-up missions as they surface.
Finish the final mission; the trophy registers at its close.
trophies.requirements: Kenton's strand unlocked through story progress.
trophies.effort: Strand length, ~1 hour across its missions

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, the lone rider of the stranger set. His missions favour a bike and open country; finish the strand and the finale pays out this trophy. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same condition.
steps: Meet Billy and complete his opening mission.
Work through his follow-up missions as they surface.
Finish the final mission; the trophy registers at its close.
trophies.requirements: Billy's strand unlocked through story progress.
trophies.effort: Strand length, ~1 hour across its missions

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. This silver is the umbrella over the individual strand trophies - Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunting line are six of them - so finishing strands for their own awards carries you most of the way. Basis: TrueAchievements and Exophase (PSN) listings agree on the count of 8.
steps: Start every stranger strand you meet; an opened strand is never wasted.
Finish strands one at a time so finales do not pile up.
Track the count on the board - the trophy registers on the 8th completed strand.
trophies.requirements: Strands unlock progressively with story progress.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy - the supply side of the stranger set, all hauling and hand-offs. Finish his strand and the finale awards this. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; strand structure per Output Lag.
steps: Meet Randy and complete his opening mission.
Work through his follow-up missions as they surface.
Finish the final mission; the trophy registers at its close.
trophies.requirements: Randy's strand unlocked through story progress.
trophies.effort: Strand length, ~1 hour across its missions

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Spin On This! - capital O on On, as served - is the strand finale award. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing, mirrored by XCT.live (Xbox catalog).
steps: Meet Tyrone and complete his opening mission.
Work through his follow-up missions as they surface.
Finish the final mission; the trophy registers at its close.
trophies.requirements: Tyrone's strand unlocked through story progress.
trophies.effort: Strand length, ~1 hour across its missions

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The method itself is plain - visit each spot and meditate - but this is the list's one live missable question: whether every spot stays reachable after its chapter passes is under investigation per PowerPyx, with U7Buy raising the same Chapter 1 concern. This guide flags it as the missable watch rather than calling it either way. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing for the trophy; the missable status is under investigation per PowerPyx.
steps: From Chapter 1 onward, meditate at every spot the first time you reach it - never leave one for later.
Keep a note of spots found; the board's watch filter keeps this trophy one tap away.
If a spot seems tied to a story location, clear it before finishing that chapter.
trophies.requirements: None to start - the habit has to begin in Chapter 1.
trophies.effort: Spread across the whole game; minutes per spot
trophies.reading: The suspicion, labelled as inference only: at least one spot appears to sit in a Chapter 1 story location, and if that location changes or closes as the story moves on, the spot could go with it. No source has confirmed a spot is lost - the investigation is open precisely because nobody has yet proved reachability either way.
trophies.safe_habit: Meditate at each spot the moment you first reach it, starting in Chapter 1, and never bank a spot for a cleanup pass. That habit makes the trophy safe under every plausible version of the rule.
trophies.confirmation: Confirmation lands when a post-launch guide or a second playthrough verifies that every spot can still be reached after the finale - or names the spot that cannot. Until then this stays a watch, not a warning.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's line is the hunting strand: take his contract, track the named animal in its territory, and make the kill cleanly so the trophy registers on the hunt, not the search. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same condition.
steps: Start Bret's hunting strand and accept the unique-animal contract.
Travel to the animal's territory and track it by its signs.
Make the kill and confirm the hunt with Bret; the trophy registers on completion.
trophies.requirements: Bret's strand unlocked; a scoped rifle helps.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida - in venues, on strangers, in the world's corners - and a set completes only when every card in it is in hand. Trade duplicates through your contacts and sweep new districts thoroughly before moving on. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; set structure per Output Lag.
steps: Pick up every card you see from the first hour - early cards anchor the common sets.
Check the collection screen to see which sets are closest, and hunt their gaps district by district.
Complete any 3 full sets; the trophy registers on the third.
trophies.requirements: Open-world access; some cards sit inside strand locations.
trophies.effort: Long collection, spread over the whole game

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations - the list's signature collectathon, exact casing WAiNKer and all. The marked locations are spread over the whole state, so treat it as a district-by-district sweep alongside your other cleanup rather than one long session. Basis: XCT.live (Xbox catalog) wording "WAiNK It at 100 locations", confirmed by Exophase (PSN).
steps: Start the sweep early so locations near story missions are banked as you pass.
Clear the map district by district, marking districts done on the board.
Use the in-game counter to find your last gaps; the trophy registers at 100.
trophies.requirements: Whole-map access for the final locations.
trophies.effort: Long collection, 4-6 hours of dedicated sweeping

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges - the game's rotating feat list (driving, combat, world and stunt challenges). Most players cross 50 without aiming at it; if you are short late, open the challenge list and farm the quick one-shot feats. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same count.
steps: Play normally and let incidental challenges accumulate.
From mid-game, glance at the challenge list when you are near a quick feat.
If a cleanup is needed, farm short repeatable challenges until the counter reads 50.
trophies.requirements: None - challenges run from the opening hours.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner riding with you, a genuine 4-star response, and then a clean break - tunnels, alleys and a vehicle swap are the reliable way out. The trophy wants the escape completed together, so do not ditch your partner mid-chase. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; condition per Output Lag.
steps: Pick up your partner and raise a 4-star Wanted Level in open view of the police.
Break line of sight and keep moving through cover until the stars start to blink.
Stay hidden until the level clears completely, partner still with you.
trophies.requirements: Partner available as a companion; a fast car staged nearby helps.
trophies.effort: Setup-dependent, ~15 minutes with a partner character

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The chain is the point: rob, move, rob again, and keep the heat alive between stores - if the stars fully clear, the chain resets. Pick three shops in one neighbourhood so travel time never cools the chase. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same condition.
steps: Choose three shops close together and bring your partner.
Rob the first and keep police attention as you drive to the second.
Rob the second and third without the Wanted Level ever fully clearing.
Escape afterwards; the trophy registers on the third robbery.
trophies.requirements: Partner available; a durable getaway car.
trophies.effort: Setup-dependent, ~20 minutes with a partner character

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles - get in, or get close enough for the game to log, 100 distinct models. Varied driving does most of it: steal across classes and districts, and visit dealerships and rich neighbourhoods for the rare metal. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; discovery logging per Output Lag.
steps: Swap vehicles often instead of living in one car.
Sweep dealerships, marinas and affluent districts for uncommon models.
Check the discovered count late-game and hunt the missing classes deliberately.
trophies.requirements: None - discovery starts with your first drive.
trophies.effort: Cumulative, lands naturally with varied driving

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. The trick is the setup, not the shooting: find or gather a group of five-plus hostiles, line up your shots, then trigger Combat Focus once and drop all five before it ends. Basis: TrueAchievements and Exophase (PSN) listings agree on the single-use condition.
steps: Find a spot where at least five enemies cluster - a gang operation works well.
Weaken or position yourself so all five are in easy reach of one another.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down all five inside the one activation.
trophies.requirements: Combat Focus ability unlocked through story progress.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA - Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: get airborne out of the airport without filing anything. Take a plane from the field and lift off; the trophy is about the departure, not the destination. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; the airport reading per Output Lag.
steps: Enter VCIA's airfield side and find a usable aircraft.
Board it and get onto a runway or open apron.
Take off and leave the airport airspace; the trophy registers on departure.
trophies.requirements: Airport access; expect a Wanted Level for the attempt.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a wink, not a method: "Kinda hot in these Rhinos." A Rhino is the game's tank, so the honest reading is that this trophy lives inside one - but no source has confirmed the exact trigger at launch, and this guide will not invent one. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; no confirmed method per Output Lag.
trophies.requirements: A Rhino tank, once you can reach one.
trophies.effort: Unknown until confirmed - the habit below costs minutes
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: the trophy almost certainly involves the Rhino tank - spending time in one, surviving in one, or raising heat in one are the plausible triggers the description gestures at. Which of those it is, and whether there is a threshold, is unconfirmed.
trophies.safe_habit: Whenever you get access to a Rhino, use it properly before moving on: drive it, fight in it, and sit in it under a Wanted Level for a while. That covers the plausible triggers in one session, whenever the chance appears.
trophies.confirmation: The trophy popping for a player inside a Rhino is the signal - post-launch reports will pin whether it was time, kills or heat, and this entry will be updated to a method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Detection is the whole puzzle: enter low-profile, control the room fast, keep anyone from raising the alarm, and be gone before a Wanted Level forms. If a witness bolts, restart the attempt - a detected robbery cannot be un-detected. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; stealth condition per Output Lag.
steps: Scout a jewelry store and note its staff and exits.
Enter masked and quiet; keep every witness covered from the first second.
Take the goods and leave before any alarm or call completes.
The trophy registers once you are clear and never detected.
trophies.requirements: A mask and a suppressed approach help; an unmarked car outside.
trophies.effort: Short, ~15 minutes with a quiet approach

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. These are the open-world counterparts to the story heist: heavier resistance, bigger takes, and a real escape afterwards - the trophy counts only vaults you get away from. Build up cash, armour and a getaway plan before each one. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; vault locations per Output Lag.
steps: Locate a bank vault and prepare: full armour, ammo, and a fast car staged a block away.
Crack the vault, take the money, and fight out to the car.
Lose the Wanted Level completely - an escape is part of the count.
Repeat at four more vaults; the trophy registers on the fifth clean escape.
trophies.requirements: Mid-game arsenal and cash reserves recommended.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run fixed routes; ambush one where the road is quiet, crack the rear doors, take the cash and break contact before the response escalates. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same condition.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and follow until the road empties.
Disable it and force the rear doors.
Grab the cash and lose the Wanted Level; the trophy registers on the escape.
trophies.requirements: A heavy vehicle or explosives to stop the truck.
trophies.effort: Short, ~15 minutes once a truck is found

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida - uncover the whole map. Exploration registers by area, so the trophy is a mop-up of every unvisited corner: drive the coast roads, cross the water to the outlying spots, and check the map for grey patches late in the game. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; full-map condition per Output Lag.
steps: Reveal the map organically while doing story and strands.
Late-game, compare the map against the state outline and list the grey areas.
Visit each remaining area until the map is fully revealed.
trophies.requirements: Whole-map access, including a boat for outlying areas.
trophies.effort: Long, folds into all other cleanup

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs its own flavour of operation; hit one of each, not five of the same. Use the map intel from strands to learn which operation belongs to whom before you go in. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; per-gang condition per Output Lag.
steps: Identify one illegal operation per gang as you uncover the map.
Rob each operation and get clear with the take.
The trophy registers when the last gang has been robbed.
trophies.requirements: Enough firepower for defended operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description - "Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach" - is all anyone has to go on at launch; no source has verified the exact spot or drink. This entry gives you the labelled reading, the habit that covers it, and the signal that will confirm it, and invents nothing. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; unconfirmed status per Output Lag.
trophies.requirements: Ocean Beach access - available from the opening hours.
trophies.effort: Minutes, if the reading below is right
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: there is likely a specific spot on Ocean Beach - a beach bar or terrace with a view - where ordering or drinking a cocktail registers the trophy. The ellipsis in the name suggests an early, quiet moment, which fits the opening hours of the game.
trophies.safe_habit: Early in the game, walk the Ocean Beach frontage and stop at every bar or terrace you find; order a cocktail wherever one is sold and take in the view for a moment. It costs a few minutes and covers every plausible version of the trigger.
trophies.confirmation: The signal is a player report or footage of the trophy popping at a named Ocean Beach spot - at that point this entry becomes a method with an address. Until then it stays unconfirmed, however obvious it looks.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The description - "Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style" - paints the scene but no source has confirmed the showroom, the vehicle or the exact exit at launch. What follows is a labelled reading, not a walkthrough. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; unconfirmed status per Output Lag.
trophies.requirements: Access to a vehicle showroom - dealerships open with the map.
trophies.effort: Minutes, if the reading below is right
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: "classic style" points at driving a car straight out through the showroom glass rather than using the door - the series' oldest showroom joke. The open questions are whether any showroom works and whether the car must be taken, not bought.
trophies.safe_habit: The first time you are inside a vehicle showroom with a car you can take, drive it out through the window instead of the exit, once. If the trophy does not pop, note the showroom and try the same at the next one you visit.
trophies.confirmation: A post-launch report naming the showroom and whether the car was stolen or purchased settles it; footage of the pop is the gold standard.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description - "Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley" - names the place and hints at the act: a bowling follow-through, most plausibly completing a game or a specific shot at that alley. It is description-led rather than confirmed, so this entry separates the reading from the fact. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; no confirmed method per Output Lag.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling there, start to finish.
If that does not register it, return for the alley's special event or challenge if one is posted.
trophies.requirements: The bowling alley unlocked on the map.
trophies.effort: Short, once you are at the alley
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: "follow-through" is bowling vocabulary - the arm motion after release - which makes a completed game at this specific alley the natural trigger. A strike or a perfect game is possible but would be a crueller reading of a bronze this cheap.
trophies.safe_habit: Play one full game at the alley the first time you pass it, and play it properly rather than guttering out - that covers the completion and performance readings in a single visit.
trophies.confirmation: The trophy popping at the alley - and players comparing whether it took a full game or a single frame - turns this reading into a method.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle - "A partnership with mass appeal" - and no method is confirmed at launch. The two words that matter are partnership and mass: something done with your partner, at scale or in public, is the shape of it. This entry will not pretend to know more than that. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; no confirmed method per Output Lag.
trophies.requirements: Your partner, and a crowd - both easy to find in Vice City.
trophies.effort: Unknown - the habit below is free
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: the likeliest shapes are a co-op feat performed in front of a crowd, a business or property milestone reached with your partner, or a shared activity repeated at volume. "Mass appeal" reads like an audience, which points at public places over private ones.
trophies.safe_habit: When you do partner activities - robberies, races, escapes - do them in busy public places rather than empty ones, and vary them. That habit brushes against every plausible version of this trigger at no extra cost.
trophies.confirmation: Any verified pop report will do it: the first guide update that names the activity and the setting converts this entry from a riddle into a method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description - "Choices made (for better or worse)" - marks this as a story-choice trophy, and the parenthetical is the tell: it most plausibly pops whichever way you choose, rewarding the choosing rather than one branch. No source has confirmed the choice point at launch, so treat every major story decision as a candidate. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; U7Buy carries the same wording.
steps: Play the story attentively and note where it offers an explicit choice.
Choose deliberately rather than by accident - either branch should count, per the description.
Watch for the trophy at the choice's outcome scene; if it does not land, the next major choice is the next candidate.
trophies.requirements: Story progress to the first major choice point.
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: "(for better or worse)" is doing real work - it reads like the trophy fires on your first irreversible story decision regardless of direction. If it instead wanted a specific branch, the description would more likely hide the whole trophy rather than joke about it.
trophies.safe_habit: Keep a manual save before every major story choice. That habit is free, it covers the branch-specific reading if the inference is wrong, and it protects the missable watch trophy on the same playthrough.
trophies.confirmation: Two players reporting the pop on opposite branches of the same choice confirms the any-choice reading; reports from one branch only would reopen the question.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. "Second time's the charm" is the whole description - a trophy about doing something again, or failing once and succeeding. No source has pinned the activity at launch, and this guide will not guess one and call it a method. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; unconfirmed status per Output Lag.
trophies.requirements: Nothing you can prepare - see the habit below.
trophies.effort: Minutes to an hour, depending on the trigger
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: the phrase describes a retry - the same attempt made twice, with the second one counting. Candidate shapes include re-attempting a challenge after a failure, robbing the same kind of target twice, or repeating a specific story beat. The trophy's cheap bronze value suggests the trigger is small and early rather than a finale.
trophies.safe_habit: Whenever an attempt at anything fails - a race, a robbery, a challenge - immediately try it once more instead of moving on. That reflex covers the retry reading wherever it applies, all game long, at almost no cost.
trophies.confirmation: The first verified pop reports will name the activity; two reports naming the same one turn this into a method. Watch for it in the first post-launch guide updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The description - "What the hell just happened?" - is a reaction, not an instruction: this is the list's weird-encounter trophy, the stranger-than-fiction moment the series always hides somewhere in its world. No source has located it at launch. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; unconfirmed status per Output Lag.
trophies.requirements: Curiosity - the encounter has to be found, not farmed.
trophies.effort: Unknown - an encounter, not a grind
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: trophies phrased as reactions usually mark a scripted oddity - a bizarre stranger encounter, a strange sighting in the wilds or the water, an event you witness rather than perform. It will happen at a place, and the trophy will pop the moment it does.
trophies.safe_habit: Investigate oddities instead of driving past them: strange lights, crowds gathered at nothing, animals behaving wrong, the marked-and-unmarked weirdness at the map's edges. When something inexplicable starts, stay and see it through.
trophies.confirmation: A located report - place, time, what happened - is the confirmation. Until one exists, anyone claiming a method for this trophy is guessing.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The description - "Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by" - is vivid but unverified: no source has confirmed the setup, the target or whether a bowling connection is literal. This entry reads the description carefully and invents nothing beyond it. Basis: description per the Exophase (PSN) listing; unconfirmed status per Output Lag.
trophies.requirements: A vehicle and a melee weapon - and probably pedestrians or pins, in some arrangement.
trophies.effort: Minutes, if the reading below is right
trophies.reading: Labelled inference: a melee drive-by is an attack with a hand weapon from a moving vehicle, and "bowl 'em over" says the targets go down in a row like pins. The plausible trigger is knocking down a group of pedestrians - or actual pins, if the bowling alley has an outdoor set - with a melee swing from a vehicle. The count, if any, is unknown.
trophies.safe_habit: When you pass a tight group of pedestrians on footpaths near the bowling alley or the beachfront, try a melee swing from a slow-rolling car or bike. It takes seconds, and if the trophy is count-based, repeat it on the next group.
trophies.confirmation: A pop report naming the target and the weapon settles whether the pins were people or pins; until then this stays a reading with a habit attached.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores and robberies; they are worthless until laundered, and only the laundered total counts here. Route dirty money through your contacts as it arrives instead of stockpiling it, and the counter climbs with your normal play. Basis: TrueAchievements and Exophase (PSN) listings agree on the $250,000 figure.
steps: Take Marked Bills from heists, robberies and strand work whenever they are offered.
Visit your laundering contacts regularly and put the full amount through.
Track the laundered total; the trophy registers as it crosses $250,000.
trophies.requirements: Laundering contacts unlocked through story and strand progress.
trophies.effort: Economy grind, folds into strand play

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops - clothing, weapons, vehicles, services, all of it counts in one pot. There is no reason to farm this: outfit both characters, keep the arsenal stocked, and buy what the other trophies need, and the milestone arrives on its own. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same figure.
steps: Spend normally from the start - outfits, ammo, armour, tuning.
Avoid hoarding: money in the bank earns nothing toward this.
If you are somehow short late, vehicle purchases close the gap fastest.
trophies.requirements: Income from story and scores.
trophies.effort: Economy milestone, lands naturally by late game

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages come onto the market as the story opens the map; buy each one as it appears rather than saving for a sweep, since garage space pays for itself in vehicle storage the whole game. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; property set per Output Lag.
steps: Check the property listings whenever a new district opens.
Buy each garage as funds allow, cheapest first.
The trophy registers when the last garage is bought.
trophies.requirements: Enough cash across the game - scores and strands cover it.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Registration is the app's ownership flow: get a vehicle, open the app, register it. Ten different vehicles, a few minutes each - steal across classes and register as you go. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; Press Start prints the same count.
steps: Unlock the Scooter Bros app through early play.
Register each new vehicle you keep, as you acquire it.
The trophy registers on the 10th registration.
trophies.requirements: The Scooter Bros app unlocked.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Vice Got a Price! is the platinum - it awards itself when every other trophy on this list is earned, and asks for nothing of its own. If you are one trophy short, it is not this one: check the board for the gap. Basis: Exophase (PSN) listing; GTABase and PowerPyx both carry the platinum in their lists.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies.
The platinum registers automatically with the last of them.
trophies.requirements: Every other trophy in this guide.
